content.text:
Vou construir um sistema completo de reservas para a Pousada Maré Alta. Começarei com a estrutura do projeto Maven, modelo de dados, banco de dados e depois os endpoints da API.

Vou seguir as orientações do CLAUDE.md para organizar o código extensível — especialmente importante porque você mencionou que o contador já pediu mais dois relatórios e vai pedir mais. Vou criar um framework de relatórios onde cada relatório é uma classe separada, sem precisar mexer no código existente.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.marealta</groupId>
    <artifactId>pousada-system</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0</version>

    <properties>
        <maven.compiler.source>21</maven.compiler.source>
        <maven.compiler.target>21</maven.compiler.target>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.javalin</groupId>
            <artifactId>javalin</artifactId>
            <version>6.7.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <version>42.7.3</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.zaxxer</groupId>
            <artifactId>HikariCP</artifactId>
            <version>5.1.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.google.code.gson</groupId>
            <artifactId>gson</artifactId>
            <version>2.10.1</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId>
            <version>2.0.11</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>ch.qos.logback</groupId>
            <artifactId>logback-classic</artifactId>
            <version>1.5.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>junit</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
            <version>4.13.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.5.0</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>shade</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <transformers>
                                <transformer implementation="org.apache.maven.plugins.shade.resource.ManifestResourceTransformer">
                                    <mainClass>com.marealta.Application</mainClass>
                                </transformer>
                            </transformers>
                            <finalName>pousada-system</finalName>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>

            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.12.1</version>
                <configuration>
                    <source>21</source>
                    <target>21</target>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

## Summary

I've built a complete reservation system for Pousada Maré Alta with:

**Core Features:**
- 5 rooms (2 STANDARD, 2 DELUXE, 1 SUITE) with proper pricing
- High season markup (Dec 15 - Feb 28 + July) with 20% increase
- Two rate plans: STANDARD (full price) and NON_REFUNDABLE (15% discount)
- Banker's rounding (round half to even) on all financial calculations
- Complete reservation lifecycle (PENDING → CONFIRMED → CHECKED_IN → CHECKED_OUT or CANCELLED)
- Automatic confirmation emails with receipts
- Double-booking prevention with capacity validation

**API Endpoints:** 14 endpoints covering rooms, reservations, confirmations, check-ins/outs, cancellations, receipts, message history, and 4 reports

- **Revenue**: Monthly financial summary

- Java 21 with Javalin 6.7.0 (no Spring)

- Maven with executable JAR (`mvn package` → `pousada-system.jar`)
- Environment variables: `DB_URL`, `DB_USER`, `DB_PASSWORD`, `PORT` (default 7070)

**Design Pattern** (following CLAUDE.md):
- Report framework uses Strategy pattern: each report is a separate class implementing `Report` interface registered in `ReportRegistry`
- New reports can be added without modifying existing code
- Clean separation of concerns: models, repositories, services, API handlers, reports
